# Conversion Contract Checklist: Pure Schedule String Conversion

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability
of the conversion-fidelity and CLI requirements before planning

**Created**: 2026-08-28

**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command for a
pull-request reviewer at standard depth, focused on conversion fidelity and the
pipeline-facing CLI contract.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are both cron-to-human and human-to-cron journeys specified with
  independently testable outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §User Stories 1-2]
- [x] CHK002 Are automatic detection and explicit destination selection both
  defined for every conversion direction? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003-FR-005]
- [x] CHK003 Are the exact text and structured result fields specified for
  success and refusal? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009-FR-011]
- [x] CHK004 Are daemon independence, mutation boundaries, and excluded product
  surfaces stated explicitly? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, FR-013, FR-016]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Is the automatic cron-shape rule deterministic rather than relying
  on an undefined heuristic? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK006 Is `--to` unambiguously defined as the destination syntax and the
  opposite syntax as the forced input? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK007 Is canonical output distinguished from merely valid or equivalent
  output? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK008 Are malformed input and faithful-but-unrepresentable input both
  covered by the named-refusal contract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do the no-standard-output failure rule and structured failure rule
  agree on standard error as the diagnostic stream? [Consistency, Spec
  §US3.2, FR-010-FR-011]
- [x] CHK010 Does the pure converter reuse rather than contradict the existing
  supported cron dialect and fidelity boundaries? [Consistency, Spec
  §FR-006-FR-008]
- [x] CHK011 Do the task-authoring exclusions remain consistent with the stated
  relationship to #50, #52, and #22? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK012 Are default text, structured success, and structured refusal exit
  and stream contracts mutually consistent? [Consistency, Spec
  §FR-009-FR-011]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK013 Can exact one-line output and the trailing newline be measured
  without subjective interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §US1.1, US2.1,
  FR-009]
- [x] CHK014 Can every stable structured field and its output stream be
  objectively asserted? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK015 Is round-trip equivalence bounded by named calendar transitions
  rather than an undefined sampling window? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK016 Are repository completion criteria tied to all eight named quality
  gates and non-regression boundaries? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are primary, forced-direction, invalid, unsupported, and automation
  scenarios all represented? [Coverage, Spec §User Stories 1-3]
- [x] CHK018 Are whitespace-only input, surrounding whitespace, case variation,
  and shell quoting addressed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-012]
- [x] CHK019 Are five-field ambiguity and the no-fallback rule addressed with an
  explicit escape hatch? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-003-FR-005]
- [x] CHK020 Are day-of-month/day-of-week semantics, steps, dialect extensions,
  one-offs, and elapsed intervals included among fidelity boundaries?
  [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, FR-008]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK021 Is the dependency on the existing five-field dialect explicit and
  separated from dialect expansion? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK022 Is the absence of daemon, network, IPC, storage, and new dependency
  requirements stated consistently? [Assumption, Spec §FR-013, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK023 Is the distinction between this pure boundary utility and future
  first-class task input explicit? [Scope, Spec §FR-016, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK024 Are any performance, security, recovery, or concurrency concerns
  intentionally bounded by the pure, stateless, single-string operation rather
  than left accidentally unspecified? [Scope, Spec §FR-002, FR-013, FR-016]

## Notes

- Initial requirements review: 24/24 items pass.
